messages:
sam: heads-up — ap-southeast canary showing a spike in 401s and a flurry of restarts after the chart bump a few minutes ago. seeing auth failures hitting token validation service.

ivy: that was my PR (gh:PR#6021) that enabled `serviceAccount.tokenRotation: true` and bumped chart to v2.14.3. also changed HPA minReplicas 1 -> 3.

sam: hmm token rotation would cause secrets to refresh; could be a race where some pods restart before auth cache warms. deploy-bot, which deploy is this?

deploy-bot: Deploy 2025-04-08T03:05:12Z by ivy/gh:PR#6021. Canary fraction 5% -> 25%. Diffs: `serviceAccount.tokenRotation: false -> true`, `hpa.minReplicas: 1 -> 3`, chart v2.13.9 -> v2.14.3. Observed symptoms: 401 rate 18%, pod restarts x3 in 4m.

oncall: pinged. recommend holding canary and not auto-rollback yet if we can hotpatch. we don't want to lose the unrelated HPA tuning change.

ivy: option A: revert tokenRotation in values and reapply chart (fast). Option B: pin chart back to v2.13.9 (loses unrelated HPA change). Option C: hotpatch current release to add `auth.cacheWarmup=true` annotation on pods/service to reduce 401s while we migrate.

sam: prefer hotpatch to preserve HPA. can you craft the patch? also please pause auto-rollback for 15m while we validate.

deploy-bot: Pausing auto-rollback for deploy 2025-04-08T03:05:12Z for 15m per request from sam. Notifying @oncall.

ivy: applying hotpatch: ```kubectl -n payments patch deployment payments-service -p '{"spec":{"template":{"metadata":{"annotations":{"auth.cache-warmup":"true"}}}}}'``` should cause controlled rolling restart and add warmup hook.

cli-bot: Hotpatch applied at 03:12 UTC. Restart triggered (rolling). New pods coming up with warmup hook.

sam: monitoring metrics — 401s dropping to 2.5% and pod churn stabilizing. HPA scaled to 3 as intended.

oncall: good. after hotpatch stabilizes we should still add a release-note line: "Temporarily disabled token rotation during migration; applied auth cache warmup hotpatch to canary in ap-southeast." Also create a follow-up to require change-window for serviceAccount rotations.

ivy: opening PR to add a preflight lint that rejects `serviceAccount.tokenRotation: true` unless `changeWindow` is set. will also backfill changelog.

sam: once stable, resume normal rollback policy. deploy-bot: please resume auto-rollback for this deploy.

deploy-bot: Resuming auto-rollback and clearing pause for deploy 2025-04-08T03:05:12Z.

ivy: thanks all. filing ticket to improve helm lint and add a note to release notes template about security-sensitive changes requiring a change window. :memo:
